CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Camden Property Trust, an S&P 500 Company, is a real estate company primarily engaged in the ownership, management, development, redevelopment, acquisition, and construction of multifamily apartment communities. Camden owns and operates 167 properties containing 56,695 apartment homes across the United States. Upon completion of 3 properties currently under development, the Company's portfolio will increase to 57,857 apartment homes in 170 properties. Camden has been recognized as one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For® by FORTUNE magazine for 19 consecutive years, most recently ranking #13.
